viewing_check: Photograph the patent plate and serial number (clean gently or angle light), check the reproducer type (Model K or L) and whether it is original, check the horn is correct Edison octagonal and crane/elbow present, check the lid chip, whether the mandrel turns and the motor runs, and note any rarer cylinders in the tin (read titles, check Blue Amberols and cracks or mould).
